responsibility: This is GCC’s main recognizer generator: it reads insn, split, and peephole2 patterns from the machine description and builds optimized decision trees for matching RTL against target patterns. It validates patterns, constructs and simplifies state graphs, factors common tests and pattern subroutines, handles optional trailing clobbers, and emits the generated recog, split_insns, and peephole2_insns implementations plus their helper subroutines, forming the core of target RTL recognition.
